title: Keith Haring's birth chart
metaDescription: Keith Haring's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 13.7° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the nine placements whose signs are settled fall in fixed signs, the widest weighting the unknown hour leaves certain. Fixed signs hold the middle of their seasons, and a fixed-heavy chart is read as one that consolidates and does not easily let go.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 13.7° Taurus. That falls in the second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — a earth sign read through a fixed season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 20.8° Aries, Venus at 29.1° Pisces, Mars at 5.6° Pisces. Mercury in a fire sign reads as a mind that decides at speaking speed; Venus in a water sign reads as taste tuned to mood and undertow; Mars in a water sign reads as drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Jupiter a sixth of the circle apart from Saturn, 0.4° off exact. A sixth of the circle is close enough for cooperation and far enough that it stays optional. Behind it, Mars trine Neptune at 2.4°, and Neptune sextile Pluto at 3.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, one sits in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Pisces at 29.1° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 fire, 3 water, 1 earth, 1 air; by modality, 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 2 cardinal. Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Scorpio into Sagittarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.6° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
